data.notes: October 2026 is already shaping up around closing-party week, with Hï Ibiza, Pacha, Ushuaïa, UNVRS, Amnesia and DC10 all publishing major end-of-season dates.

events.title: Purple Disco Machine | Pure Pacha - Closing Party
events.summary: Pure Pacha’s 2026 closing party is headlined by Purple Disco Machine, with Gerd Janson, Busy P and Breakbot also listed. The official Pacha page confirms Thursday, 1 October 2026 at Pacha Ibiza.

events.title: Calvin Harris - Closing Party
events.summary: Calvin Harris closes his Friday Ushuaïa Ibiza run on 2 October 2026, with MK and Tyson O’Brien listed on the official event page. The source confirms a 17:00 start at the open-air Playa d’en Bossa venue.

events.title: CAMELPHAT Present Summer of Love - Closing Party
events.summary: CAMELPHAT’s Summer of Love closes at Hï Ibiza on Friday, 2 October 2026, with Ewan McVicar, Jayda G and Edd listed in the Club Room. Hï Ibiza confirms the residency’s second 2026 run ends on this date.

events.title: ANTS at Ushuaïa Ibiza
events.summary: ANTS takes over Ushuaïa Ibiza on Saturday, 3 October 2026, with Franky Rizardo, Nic Fanciulli B2B SOSA, Bontan B2B Rafael, Ranger Trucco B2B Robbie Doherty, Meeshy and Raul Rodriguez listed. The official page confirms a 15:00 start.

events.title: Black Coffee - Closing Party
events.summary: Black Coffee closes his flagship Saturday Hï Ibiza residency on 3 October 2026, with Dorian Craft in the Theatre and Skepta’s Más Tiempo concept in the Club Room. Hï Ibiza lists the season as running from 2 May to 3 October 2026.

events.title: Solomun+1 - Closing Party
events.summary: Solomun+1 closes its 2026 Pacha Ibiza season on Sunday, 4 October 2026. Resident Advisor lists Solomun for the closing party at Pacha Ibiza from 23:00 to 06:00.

events.title: Carl Cox - Closing Party
events.summary: Carl Cox closes his [UNVRS] Sunday residency on 4 October 2026 with an all-night-long Main Room set, plus melon bomb in Wild Comet. The official [UNVRS] page confirms the date and a 23:30 start.

events.title: MESTIZA & Indira Paganotto Presents ARTCORE - Closing Party
events.summary: Hï Ibiza’s Sunday closing date pairs MESTIZA in the Theatre with Indira Paganotto’s ARTCORE in the Club Room on 4 October 2026. The official event page lists Floyd Lavine, Dan Tanev, Pan-Pot, Anetha, Interactive Noise and Sirus Hood among the bill.

events.title: F*** ME I'M FAMOUS! By David Guetta
events.summary: David Guetta’s F*** ME I’M FAMOUS! closes its 2026 Ushuaïa Ibiza run on Monday, 5 October 2026, with Afrojack, Matt Sassari and Paul Reynolds listed. The official event page confirms a 17:00 start.

events.title: Glitterbox at Amnesia Ibiza - Closing Date
events.summary: Glitterbox’s 2026 Amnesia Ibiza residency is confirmed to run every Friday from 15 May until 9 October 2026. The Amnesia source describes the move as a new chapter for Glitterbox at one of Ibiza’s historic clubs.

events.title: Marco Carola Presents Music On - Closing Party Part 2
events.summary: Music On closes its 2026 Pacha Ibiza season with Part 2 on Friday, 9 October 2026. Pacha lists Marco Carola, Franky Rizardo, East End Dubs, Ilario Alicante, Ale De Tuglie and Grace Arribas on the bill.

events.title: CircoLoco Ibiza - The Closing Party
events.summary: CircoLoco’s 2026 DC-10 closing party is confirmed for Monday, 12 October 2026. Resident Advisor lists the event at DC-10 from 18:00 to 06:00, with lineup still TBA.
